newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank sells $70 mln at 26.375.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank sells $70 mln at 26.375.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank sold about $70 million in early trades at 26.375 pesos on Thursday, traders said.
The move came after the Central Bank lifted its overnight borrowing rate to 12 percent from 11.25 as a pre-emptive move to tame speculation in the peso.
Late Wednesday, traders said the Central Bank unloaded $62 million at 26.375 as the peso was also hit by speculation arising from the problems of the Thai baht.
The peso traded at 26.375/26.372 in early morning trades on Thursday with volume heavy at $94 million.
